name: Luis Enríquez de Guzmán, 9th Count of Alba de Liste
wikipedia: Luis Enríquez de Guzmán, 9th Count of Alba de Liste
role: Viceroy of New Spain and Peru

checks.lead: Don Luis Enríquez de Guzmán, 9th Count of Alba de Liste (Spanish: Don Luis Enríquez de Guzmán, marqués de Villaflor y noveno conde de Alba de Liste; also sometimes, Luis Henríquez de Guzmán, conde de Alba de Aliste) (c. 1600 – March 12, 1667) was viceroy of New Spain from June 28, 1650 to August 14, 1653 and thereafter viceroy of Peru, from February 24, 1655 to December 31, 1661).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
